messages:
Marta: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6789 needs runtime + infra + security review for a small quant/pack change. Summary: new compact int8 packing + minor KV layout change. Affects kernel selection and may touch fallback path. planning a merge window Tue next week, want to gather owners.

Ryan: on it. can you paste the perf numbers and a note if this changes fallback semantics for long sequences?

Marta: perf: seq512 throughput +12% median, p95 latency +2%. Added a flag compact_pack=true; that alters KV layout slightly so runtime needs to sanity-check cache hits/eviction. No network/perms changes.

Sam: I can own infra side (artifacts, storage, deployment packaging). any new artifact locations or perms?

Marta: artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/repo/6789/. no new perms beyond standard artifact bucket. SBOM and build metadata are included at https://artifacts.redwood/repo/6789/sbom.json

Alice: security here — can you confirm SBOM covers the compiled kernels and include the build attestations? I need to verify provenance. If you add the attestations link I can do a review by EOD.

Marta: added attestations: https://artifacts.redwood/repo/6789/attestation.json. also added a focused test: tests/kv_pack_test.py. run: `pytest -k kv_pack`.

Ryan: thanks. I'll run the kv test and a long-seq integration (see command below) and report back in ~1h.

Marta: integration command: `PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/integration_longseq.py::test_long_seq --maxfail=1 -q` — passes locally but worth CI run.

merge-bot: NOTICE: requested merge window Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — add the `merge-ready` label when all approvals are present.

Sam: I'll take infra approval once security and runtime sign off. tagging @Ryan to coordinate.

Ryan: tests running now (kv + longseq). if green I'll +1 for runtime.

Alice: started security review. one minor audit note about kernel provenance format, leaving a comment on the PR. should be quick to resolve.

Marta: excellent, thanks all :thumbsup: — if anyone wants a smaller canary before full rollout I can schedule one.

Ryan: will update in thread when tests finish.

Alice: posted review comment re: attestation schema; nothing blocking.

Ryan: kv + longseq green locally and on CI smoke. runtime +1.

Sam: infra +1 (artifacts look good).

Marta: added `merge-ready` label. thanks team — planning canary Tue morning then full merge after canary clears.
